rules.cwe_name: Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs
rules.description: Checking for the "javascript:" URL scheme without also checking for "vbscript:" and "data:" suggests a logic error or even a security vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If an HTML element has two attributes with the same name but different values, its behavior may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS)
rules.description: A sanitizer that removes a sequence of characters may reintroduce the dangerous sequence.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Using indexOf to implement endsWith functionality is error-prone if the -1 case is not explicitly handled.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: DOM functions that act like 'eval' and execute strings as code are dangerous and impede program analysis and understanding. Consequently, they should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: A jQuery plugin that unintentionally constructs HTML from some of its options may be unsafe to use for clients.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Handling of Case Sensitivity
rules.description: Middleware with case-sensitive paths do not protect endpoints with case-insensitive paths.

rules.cwe_name: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
